title: PVP Leaderboard
author: Doctor Schnell & Claude (Anthropic)
description: Persistent PVP leaderboard tracking kills, deaths, streaks, and headshots across four time windows (all-time, 24h, 7d, 30d). Each window is a spawnable metal-framed floating sign entity with 3D2D rendering, and the !pvpboard panel switches between them. Integrates with PVP Combat Timer for kill validation.
